{{Quote|How much time do we have?"<br />"That depends on your number. Lower ones go first. But you'll get your turn, I'm sure.|[[Eogan Truax]] and [[Iram Radique]], after the launch of the Omega Initiative|<ref name="Lock">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Omega Initiative''''' was a fail-safe mechanism designed to systematically trigger the [[Subatomic electrostatic detonator|electrostatic charges]] implanted in the [[Heart/Legends|hearts]] of all the [[Prisoner/Legends|inmates]] in the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Lock" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="Insider 146">{{InsiderCite|146|Blaster}}</ref> [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Sadiki Blirr]] launched this mechanism after the prison was [[Mission to Cog Hive Seven|attacked]] by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] forces. Most of the prison inmates [[Death/Legends|perished]] as the result.<ref name="Lock" />
